hero.kicker: your wardrobe, but in a notebook
hero.lead: Add your clothes once and stop wondering what to wear: build outfits from what you already own, or ask the AI for one.

login.title: Log in
login.body: Sign in with your email and password. Your wardrobe is yours alone: nobody else sees your clothes.

garments.title: Add your clothes
garments.body: Add each piece with a photo and the basics: category, colors, season and how formal it is.

outfits.title: Build outfits
outfits.body: Pick pieces from your wardrobe and layer them: the tee underneath, the shirt on top, the jacket outside.

ai.title: Ask the AI for one
ai.body: Tell it what you need in one sentence and the AI builds an outfit using only your clothes. If you like it, save it.
ai.example: something comfy for a rainy friday

outro.title: Ready?
outro.body: Your next outfit is already in your wardrobe. You just have to find it.
